Paramount and Warner Bros Merge in $110 Billion Deal

Paramount and Warner Bros have merged in a deal valued at $110 billion, bringing major film, television, and news brands under a single corporate entity. The merger's closing followed settlements with a coalition of US states and a Hollywood writers union, which resolved the primary legal obstacles. The new company is reportedly targeting cost cuts, with layoffs anticipated.
